description: Insert an RFC 2822 message into the mailbox without sending it

full.description: Include sensitive values in output (passwords, tokens)

examples.description: Show usage examples with response shapes

flags-for.description: Show flags for a use case: filtering, output, pagination, auth, bulk

profile.description: Named profile from the config file

instance.description: Named instance within the profile, for providers with more than one; embedding hosts pass it through

confirm.description: Confirm a command that requires explicit confirmation

identity-token.description: Identity token verified by the configured identity provider

service-account-key.description: Google service account JSON key content

delegated-user.description: Email of user to impersonate via Domain-Wide Delegation

from.description: Sender (From: header). Required for import — the message can be attributed to anyone.

to.description: Recipient(s) (To: header), comma-separated. Typically the importing mailbox itself.

date.description: RFC 2822 Date header (e.g. "Mon, 03 Mar 2026 09:00:00 +0000"). Drives Gmail internal date when --internal-date-source=dateHeader.

message-id.description: RFC Message-ID (without angle brackets). If omitted, Gmail assigns one — set explicitly for deterministic threading across imports.

in-reply-to.description: Message-ID of the parent message for threading (without angle brackets).

references.description: Whitespace-separated Message-IDs of ancestor messages in the thread.

attachment.description: Path to a file to attach (repeatable). Each value is an absolute path readable by the runtime; the file is base64-encoded into a multipart/mixed part.

label-names.description: Comma-separated user-visible label names to apply at import time (e.g. "candidate,hiring"). Missing labels are auto-created.

never-mark-spam.description: Tell Gmail to skip spam classification on this message.

process-for-calendar.description: Extract calendar invites from the message and add them to Google Calendar.

internal-date-source.description: Source for Gmail internal date: "dateHeader" (default, uses Date: header) or "receivedTime" (now).
